records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project or key milestone despite two outreach emails (email:ada0cde6, email:56dee596) with zero replies and no tickets. One invite sent shows some intent, but silence plus no first project with 8 days left makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: One quick step to get your first project going
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Following up on my note last week — glad to see a teammate invited. The next step that usually makes everything click is creating a first project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, so it's a short one.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with you and your teammate so the tasks you care about have a home.

Best,
Nadia
